newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures lower, off lows after US data.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures lower, off lows after US data.

text.p: Aug 1 - IMM currency futures were moderately lower, off lows hits after July US nonfarm payrolls rose 316,000, jobless rate fell to 4.8 pct. Avg hourly earnings were unchanged, factory jobs fell 5,000. Traders expected 193,000 payrolls rise, 4.9-pct joblessness, 0.2-pct hrly earnings rise. June personal income, spending rose 0.3 pct vs expected up 0.4 pct.
